note: One record per experiment, owner row and blocked row. 'state_key' / 'state_subkey' / 'state_field' / 'state_expect' locate the matching text in the loop's STATE.json; verify_artifacts.py checks that the text is there and that its first terminal token equals 'disposition', and lists every mismatch with 'diff_reason'. Owner-row keys are written kvnloo/cua#N and mapped back to STATE's key form by the verifier. 'pending' is non-null for every row that a later wave can still move (see PENDING.md).
